extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: EuroSAT is a novel satellite image dataset for land use and land cover classification based on Sentinel-2 satellite images, covering 13 spectral bands and consisting of 10 classes with 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.publisher: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded from Sentinel-2A via Amazon S3, covering European cities distributed in over 34 countries. Images with low cloud levels were selected. A dataset of 27,000 georeferenced and labeled image patches (64x64 pixels) was created, with patches manually checked and labeled across 10 land use/land cover classes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral satellite images from Sentinel-2A covering 13 spectral bands, associated with European cities covered in the European Urban Atlas, distributed over 34 European countries.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Image patches were manually checked and labeled into 10 land use/land cover classes based on the European Urban Atlas mapping guide
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: European Urban Atlas used as reference for class definitions and mapping
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The patch-based classification system does not allow finely graduated per-pixel segmentation, limiting its use for detailed mapping tasks.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables applications in agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change monitoring, urban development, and environmental monitoring. It can be used to detect deforestation (a contributor to climate change), monitor urban development, and assist in keeping geographical maps up-to-date.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for training and benchmarking deep learning models for land use and land cover classification. Use cases include land use/land cover change detection, improvement of geographical maps, and large-scale Earth observation monitoring.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images were extracted from across all seasons and multiple countries to maximize intra-class variance; dataset balanced with 2,000 to 3,000 images per class across 10 classes for a total of 27,000 images; 80/20 training-test split used for benchmarking
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Satellite images with low cloud coverage were selected; image patches of 64x64 pixels were extracted and georeferenced; patches were manually checked and labeled into 10 land use/land cover classes
